## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Treatment Product
where: ReportService (uses), src/business/reportService.ts, component business

=====SOURCE-BEGIN
const productNames = new Map(this.products.findAll().map((p) => [p.id, p.name]));
=====SOURCE-END=====

response.rationale: These are two different concepts. A Treatment Product is a catalog entry: ReportService builds a map of product ids to names from `this.products.findAll()`, which calls TreatmentProductRepository.findAll. A Treatment is a recorded application event on a hive: TreatmentRepository keeps `TreatmentRecord[]` items, looked up through findByHive, and written by TreatmentService.recordTreatment. Each treatment probably points to a product by id, which is why ReportService uses the product id-to-name map. That makes it a reference between two concepts, not one concept under two names. Each also has its own repository class.
